title: Kissed Juicy Norwegian Beef Burger
description: A resinous, juicy, and indulgent Norwegian dish featuring sesame seed burger buns and roast, low-fat-friendly beef patties.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, combine the Norwegian beef, roast seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper, then mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball, then flatten each ball into a patty.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the patties are cooking, toast the sesame seed burger buns in the oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of low-fat mayo on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a slice of cheese, a few slices of onion, a few slices of tomato, and a handful of chopped lettuce.
Top with the top bun and serve immediately.
Repeat the assembly process with the remaining ingredients.
